# discord_local_image (Data Source)

Reads a local image as a data URI for server icons, invite splashes, webhook avatars, and emojis. Content changes update the data URI even at the same path. Stickers require file paths instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_local_image" "icon" {
  file = "${path.module}/assets/icon.png"
}

resource "discord_managed_server" "example" {
  server_id     = var.server_id
  name          = "Example Server"
  icon_data_uri = data.discord_local_image.icon.data_uri
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `file` (String) The path to the local image file.

### Read-Only

- `data_uri` (String) The base64-encoded data URI of the image (e.g., `data:image/png;base64,...`).
